segments.name: Community banking
segments.description: Full-service community bank serving businesses and individuals in Kentucky, North Carolina and Tennessee.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all of the financial service operations are considered by management to aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns fees from customers for debit card transactions and other services such as insurance commissions and safe deposit box rent.
revenueModel.evidence: the Bank charges a fee, typically a fixed amount, which is recognized as revenue upon the completion of the transaction.
